message:
1 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:35: interpolation reads `label` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence in a context a `@let` holds, handed to an outlet by name (measured: drawn). Only a map literal written in the binding is read by its keys; any other context is taken whole by every variable, `let-label="label"` among them — read as the binding's own name alone, it took nothing.
